legacy.claim: Linearized about a uniform rest background, the existing packet Hamiltonian and continuity/flux system has 2+2d first-order fields, four propagating longitudinal acoustic branches, and 2(d−1) transverse zero-frequency current modes; there is no Gauss constraint and no propagating transverse polarization. Equal c₊=c₋ degenerates the two longitudinal cones without converting either into a Maxwell polarization.
